purpose: Collect multiline text with field labeling, validation feedback, optional character counting, and vertical resizing.

notes: Use VeliProvider for localized tooltip and resize labels, direction, and Dhivehi typography.

useWhen: A form needs free-form text that may span multiple lines.
Users benefit from a maximum-length counter or bounded vertical resizing.

avoidWhen.situation: The expected value is a short single line.

supportedInteractions: Pointer-driven vertical resizing within optional height bounds
Focus by clicking the field shell
approvedPatterns: Pair the character counter with a maximum length.
Use description text normally and errorMessage when invalid.
Set explicit minimum or maximum height only when the surrounding flow requires bounds.
limitations: Direct child composition and style overrides are not supported.
className is intended for outer layout.
accessibility: Uses React Aria TextField, Label, and TextArea semantics.
The custom resize control has a localized accessible label.
Required, disabled, read-only, and invalid states are exposed through React Aria.
responsive: The field fills its container and can grow vertically; constrain width in the surrounding layout.
rtl: Field content and the resize indicator follow the active direction.
Dhivehi text uses localized typography metrics.
